facts: Normalizing a path collapses repeated separators and removes `.` segments.
A path that still contains a `..` segment after normalization is rejected.
Two entries that normalize to the same path are reported as one duplicate group.
fact_paraphrases: Repeated separators are collapsed and `.` segments are dropped during normalization.
Normalization removes `.` segments and duplicate separators.
Any path with a `..` segment left after normalization is rejected.
A surviving `..` segment makes the entry invalid.
Entries sharing one normalized path form a single duplicate group.
Duplicate groups are reported by their shared normalized path.
